claims.statement: The proposed paid unit is an accepted participant-week or endpoint dataset, while rejected or missing endpoints are the measurable operational loss; price and rejection rates are unvalidated.
Sponsors and CROs procure clinical-trial operations and are the hypothesised budget holders, but no sponsor interview, study pipeline, or budget commitment is evidenced.

The founder would need a clinic or investigator master-services agreement plus sponsor-approved work orders; background knowledge and a medical-student relationship grant no clinical access or authority.

European regulators describe decentralised elements such as home visits, home shipment, and electronic consent, while the Clinical Trials Regulation preserves sponsor, consent, and oversight obligations.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Clinical operations, digital endpoints, data management, or study program lead
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Focus on a narrow neurology endpoint and Central European local execution, while interoperating with sponsor-selected devices rather than replacing the trial platform
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Sponsor, CRO, investigator, and clinic under the study agreements
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: CRO vendor qualification, sponsor digital-endpoint teams, and contracted clinic investigators

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Vendor qualification, validation work, and sponsor sales; likely high and slow before the first study
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Setup deposit and monthly milestone invoices; sponsor or CRO acceptance cycles may delay cash
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Unvalidated target 30-50% after qualified labor, devices, logistics, and participant support
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Scheduled local operations with protocol automation; safety, clinical judgment, and deviations remain with qualified study personnel
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: GCP-quality systems, privacy, security, insurance, training records, device calibration, audit readiness, and legal review
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Hypothesis: 25000-75000 PLN study setup plus 350-900 PLN per accepted participant-week, depending on device and visit burden
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Qualified rater or technician time, device logistics, participant support, connectivity, travel, translation, and data-quality review

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Global CROs, specialist eClinical vendors, and device companies can bundle sites, devices, support, and validated analytics
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Paid event is an accepted setup milestone, participant-week, or endpoint dataset under the study work order; measurable loss is a missing or rejected endpoint and the cost of repeating or extending recruitment
commercial_mechanics.payer: Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical-device, or digital-biomarker sponsor, usually through a CRO
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: An approved protocol needs home or hybrid endpoints in Poland or nearby markets and existing sites cannot deliver the logistics or data quality
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: A new cohort, protocol amendment, follow-on study, additional geography, or master-services renewal

contrary_evidence: Large CROs and established decentralised-trial vendors already possess qualification systems, sponsor relationships, and global device logistics.
Neurology endpoints may require validation, specialist judgment, or in-person assessment that limits home collection.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Proposed 24-month nonexclusive master services agreement with a clinic or investigator network, followed by a study-specific work order and data-processing terms
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Serve non-interventional feasibility studies through another qualified clinic, provide sponsor-only data-QA software, or stop the clinical workflow rather than bypass oversight
critical_control_point.current_owner: Investigators, clinics, sponsors, and CROs; the founder controls no current clinical or participant relationship
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Sponsor, CRO, investigator, and clinic under the study agreements
critical_control_point.duration: Proposed 24-month master term; study work orders follow protocol duration
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: Neuroscience expertise and a medical-student partner provide domain understanding, not clinic authority, participant access, professional qualification, ethics approval, or data rights.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Sponsor or CRO, principal investigator, clinic, ethics and competent authorities where applicable, and each consenting participant
critical_control_point.renewal: Annual renewal after the initial term based on audit findings, participant safety, quality, and delivery
critical_control_point.subject: Clinic-approved participant-contact, assessment, device-logistics, and data-quality workflow for a named study

economics.acquisition_route: CRO vendor qualification and investigator partnerships tied to a specific protocol need
economics.founder_net_worth_path: A repeatable Central European endpoint network could become an acquisition target; a 5m PLN outcome likely needs several sponsor programs and multi-country replication over 5-8 years
economics.founder_time: Up to five hours per day only if qualified clinical work and participant support are staffed independently
economics.gross_margin_basis: Study revenue less qualified labor, devices, logistics, support, QA, insurance, and CRO or clinic share
economics.payback: Target setup-fee coverage of validation and onboarding, with participant units contributing thereafter; not evidenced
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 25000-75000 PLN setup plus 350-900 PLN per accepted participant-week
economics.retention_or_repeat: Repeat through cohorts, follow-on protocols, additional endpoints, and sponsor master agreements

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Protocol-level operations data reveal which devices, instructions, schedules, and support interventions produce acceptable endpoints
fingerprint.customer: Clinical-trial sponsors, contract research organisations, and digital-biomarker developers running neurology studies in Central Europe
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Contract into CRO and sponsor study plans through clinic and investigator partnerships
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Managed local node for recruitment coordination, device logistics, scheduled non-diagnostic assessments, support, and protocol-defined data QA
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Sponsor or CRO pays setup fees and per accepted participant-week or accepted endpoint dataset
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A protocol includes home or hybrid digital endpoints but the sponsor lacks local participant operations and reproducible signal-quality control

founder_fit: Neuroscience and data-science background align with endpoint quality and protocol analytics
The founder can automate scheduling, signal QA, and exception detection while clinical duties stay with qualified personnel
A single-study node can be tested below the exceptional-capital threshold if devices are leased or sponsor-supplied
The work is B2B and operational rather than dependent on an on-camera audience
risks: Protocol deviation or poor signal quality can damage a sponsor program
Handling sensitive health data and participant contact creates serious privacy and security obligations
Long enterprise qualification and study cycles may exceed runway
The founder cannot personally perform regulated clinical roles without qualification and appointment

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: study setup plus per accepted participant week or endpoint dataset
structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: clinic approved local workflow for participant contact devices assessments and qa
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: qualified investigators raters and technicians under protocol oversight

structure.control_point: contracted clinic and investigator workflow for eligible participant operations
structure.critical_dependency: qualified investigators, raters, and technicians operating under sponsor-approved protocol and oversight

thesis: Future operating state (2030): decentralised neurological studies routinely collect protocol-grade motor, speech, sleep, and cognition signals from participants at home. Missing physical and coordination mechanism: clinic-approved recruitment, trained local operators, calibrated device custody, participant support, and an auditable data-quality chain that a sponsor can treat as an accepted study deliverable.
title: Neurology Home-Endpoint Operations
uncertainties: Sponsor demand for a Poland-focused node and the addressable study pipeline
Which proposed signals are exploratory, validated endpoints, medical-device outputs, or clinical assessments
Investigator, ethics, insurance, and competent-authority requirements for each protocol
